title: My BMW (Google Play de.bmw.connected.mobile20.na) customer reviews, US storefront

sampling.method: Google Play reviews, newest first, all available up to the scraper limit; scrapers/app_reviews.py
limitations: Google Play filters reviews mainly by language; the storefront country is a weak market signal.
Market is the storefront country, not the reviewer's residence.
Reviews concern the companion app, not a specific vehicle model; subject_ids stay empty until the catalog has an app entity.

provenance.notes: Collected with scrapers/app_reviews.py from the public Google Play review endpoints. DimXxxID values are this warehouse's surrogate keys (see scrapers/warehouse.py), resolved into markets.

export_permissions.notes: Unresolved: scraped third-party review text; keep out of Git and external LLMs until decided.
